name: Aizawa Attractor
desc: A luminous Aizawa strange attractor integrated tens of thousands of steps per frame into a glowing density field, its gold polar spiral threading a slowly-tumbling indigo spherical shell that rotates on two incommensurate axes and never repeats.

scale.doc: projection zoom (higher = attractor fills more of the frame)

density.doc: iterate count per frame (45k-90k) — higher = denser, brighter form

speed.doc: tumble rate of the two incommensurate rotations
